lead.headline: Jacobs and Seattle cut the lead to 20.75 — Lamb and Pierce decide it
lead.deck: Every AVIATO player is final at 89.76. ESPN now gives JuiceJam 65%. When the week rolls, Allen goes back in.
lead.body: Start with the bad news: Garrett Wilson drew three targets for 4.6 while Geno Smith threw three touchdowns to others, Isaiah Likely caught two for 12 in McCarthy's first Giants start, DK Metcalf managed 7.6 on six targets, and the Broncos D/ST gave back half their points to finish on 4. Overnight Josh Jacobs scored 20.1 and the Seahawks D/ST 10 for JuiceJam, so a 47.9-point lead is now 20.75 with CeeDee Lamb and Dameon Pierce left tonight. Kamara's 13.2 sat on the bench behind a projection-backed flex call. Nothing is left to set. Next week Likely, Fairbairn and Kamara are on bye; Allen returns to the QB slot, and Tuesday picks a tight end and a kicker.
